name: Meshy
description: Leading 3D generative AI platform. Transforms text and images into 3D models in minutes. #1 in global 3D GenAI market with 6M+ users.

founders.name: Ethan (Yuanming) Hu
achievements: SIGGRAPH 2022 Outstanding Doctoral Dissertation Honorable Mention
Original author of Taichi programming language
Contributed to MLS-MPM for VFX simulations

funding.notes: Backed by Sequoia and GGV. Team includes alumni from MIT, Stanford, Berkeley, and veterans from Nvidia and Microsoft.

employees.notes: Small distributed team of 3D artists, designers, and developers

recognition: Only 3D AI tool in A16Z Games 2024 Annual Report

recent_news.title: Meshy Hits $15M ARR with 30% Month-over-Month Growth
Meshy Unveils Meshy 6 Preview for Next-Gen 3D Creation
Featured in A16Z Games 2024 Annual Report

score_notes.founder: MIT PhD in CG/AI, SIGGRAPH award, Taichi creator - strong but first-time founder
score_notes.financial: $15M ARR is early-stage, but 85% gross margin and 30% MoM growth impressive for size
score_notes.funding: $150M valuation, seed-stage. Sequoia/GGV backing is strong but small raise
score_notes.momentum: Great growth rate but on small base - 30% MoM on $15M vs billions for leaders
score_notes.product: Meshy 6 is solid, good API - but early-stage product maturity
score_notes.traction: 6M users mostly free tier, $15M ARR shows low monetization. Niche market.
score_notes.community: Strong Discord, 3M monthly visits - good for category
score_notes.market: #1 in small $10B 3D GenAI TAM. Niche leadership vs LLM $500B+ TAM
